countries.title: Buyer countries
countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes of the buyer's country (e.g. DEU, FRA, ITA, ESP, NLD). Leave empty for all EU/EEA countries.

cpvCodes.title: CPV codes
cpvCodes.description: Common Procurement Vocabulary codes to filter by (e.g. 72000000 for IT services, 45000000 for construction). Exact 8-digit codes only. Leave empty for all.

noticeTypes.title: Notice types
noticeTypes.description: TED notice-type codes to filter by, e.g. cn-standard (contract notice), can-standard (contract award notice), pin-standard (prior information). Leave empty for all types.

publishedWithinDays.title: Published within (days)
publishedWithinDays.description: Only return notices published in the last N days. Ignored if publicationDateFrom or publicationDateTo is set.

publicationDateFrom.title: Published from (absolute date)
publicationDateFrom.description: YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides 'Published within (days)' with an absolute historical window. Leave empty for no lower bound (with publicationDateTo set).

publicationDateTo.title: Published to (absolute date)
publicationDateTo.description: YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides 'Published within (days)'. Leave empty for no upper bound (with publicationDateFrom set).

keywords.title: Keywords (full-text)
keywords.description: Free-text search across the notice's title, description and buyer name (TED's FT~ full-text operator). Example: "cloud hosting". Leave empty to match everything in your other filters.

expertQuery.title: Expert query (advanced, overrides the filters above)
expertQuery.description: Raw TED expert-query string (same syntax as the TED website's expert search), e.g. "buyer-country=DEU AND classification-cpv=72000000 AND publication-date>=today(-30)". If set, this replaces countries/cpvCodes/noticeTypes/publishedWithinDays entirely.
